behaviors: Contains site logo and primary navigation; remains fixed at top of page.
keyboardExpectations: Navigation links are focusable in tab order; skip link precedes header.

behaviors: Horizontal list at breakpoint >=48em; collapses to vertical menu with hamburger button below. Button toggles aria-expanded and shows/hides menu.
keyboardExpectations: Hamburger button is focusable; activates with Enter or Space. Escape closes menu and returns focus to button. Menu items are focusable in tab order.

behaviors: Contains copyright text and minimal site footer navigation; flows after main content.
keyboardExpectations: Links are focusable in tab order.

behaviors: Shows site tagline, description, and primary call‑to‑action button; centered text.
keyboardExpectations: CTA button is focusable; activates with Enter or Space.

behaviors: CSS grid layout with auto‑fit columns (minmax 200px, 1fr) and gap; wraps cards responsively.
keyboardExpectations: Inherits focus order from child card elements.

behaviors: Displays thumbnail image, title, description or summary, and tag list; consistent card styling.
keyboardExpectations: Entire card is not interactive; internal links (if any) are focusable.

behaviors: Shows thumbnail image, title, excerpt or tip, meta (date, reading‑time or category), tag list, and a button that triggers a simulated lightbox.
keyboardExpectations: Button is focusable; activates with Enter or Space to open lightbox.

behaviors: Fieldset containing checkboxes for filtering displayed items; changes trigger re‑render of card grid.
keyboardExpectations: Each checkbox is focusable; toggles with Space. Change event fires on interaction.

behaviors: Collects name, email, and message; validates required fields and email format; shows inline errors and error summary; on submit displays simulated thank‑you message.
keyboardExpectations: All inputs and textarea are focusable; submit button activates with Enter or Space. Focus moves to first error or thank‑you message after submit.
